title.en: Prophylactic hemostasis for nonbleeding vessels should be guided by vessel size. Very large vessels that do not hamper tunnel progression should be avoided; vessels up to 1–1.5 mm should be pretreated using the knife, and vessels larger than 1.5–2 mm should be considered for prophylactic treatment using coagulation forceps.
